frontMatter.about:
At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, employees play a key role in supporting the organization’s manufacturing and export operations and in upholding its reputation for quality and reliability. Your skills, commitment, and professionalism contribute directly to maintaining operational standards and meeting customer and buyer expectations.
The organization is engaged in apparel manufacturing and exports, serving international markets through structured processes, quality controls, and responsible business practices. Every function across production, quality, merchandising, logistics, administration, and support has an important role in ensuring consistency, compliance, and timely delivery.
This Employee Handbook is intended to help you understand the company’s work culture, policies, and expectations, as well as the systems and practices that guide daily operations. We welcome you to Rakheja Enterprises LLP and look forward to your contribution as we continue to strengthen our capabilities and long-term partnerships.
At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, our purpose is to build a responsible and resilient organization that consistently delivers quality products while operating with integrity and accountability. We aim to support our customers through dependable manufacturing operations, disciplined processes, and ongoing improvement aligned with industry and regulatory requirements.
We are committed to maintaining high standards in apparel manufacturing and business practices, while integrating sustainability, compliance, and efficiency into daily decision-making. By focusing on quality, operational reliability, and ethical conduct, we strive to strengthen long-term trust with our customers, employees, and business partners across global markets.

Rakheja Enterprises LLP is committed to maintaining a merit-based, transparent, inclusive, and legally compliant recruitment and employment framework. The Company ensures that all hiring, compensation, performance evaluation, and employment practices are fair, objective, and aligned with operational standards, ethical values, and long-term business objectives.

chapters.title: Recruitment & Selection Principles
chapters.text:
## 🔹Merit-Based Hiring
All recruitment decisions are based strictly on job-relevant qualifications, skills, experience, competencies, and demonstrated performance. Each role is supported by a clearly defined job description outlining responsibilities and selection criteria. Internal and external candidates are provided equal opportunity to apply for open positions, including through the Internal Job Posting (IJP) system.

chapters.title: 🔹Equal Employment Opportunity & Non-Discrimination
chapters.text:
The Company provides equal employment opportunities and strictly prohibits discrimination on the basis of gender, age, nationality, race, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
Recruitment practices are designed to minimize bias and promote impartiality, including:
- Use of inclusive and neutral job descriptions
- Objective screening and evaluation criteria
- Structured panel interviews
- Standardized scoring methods
- Training for interviewers to mitigate unconscious bias
## Recruitment Process & Procedures
The Company follows a structured and transparent recruitment process to ensure consistency and fairness:
- Approved vacancies are advertised through appropriate internal and external channels.
- Applications are screened using objective, job-related criteria.
- Age verification is conducted during the recruitment and onboarding process to ensure compliance with the minimum legal working age and to prevent child labour. Candidates are required to submit valid government-issued identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Birth Certificate, or School Leaving Certificate as proof of age. The HR department verifies these documents, particularly the Aadhaar card, to confirm the candidate’s date of birth before employment is finalized.
- Where feasible, resumes may be anonymized during initial screening to reduce unconscious bias.
- Structured interviews are conducted by HR and departmental representatives or panel members.
- Final selection decisions are based on consolidated assessment results and panel feedback.
- Candidates are informed of application outcomes in a timely manner, and feedback may be provided where appropriate.
All recruitment activities comply with applicable legal, ethical, and labour standards.
## Compensation & Salary Structure
Compensation decisions are guided by fairness, internal parity, and market competitiveness.
- Salary offers are determined based on role responsibilities, qualifications, experience, skill level, and industry benchmarks — not solely on previous compensation.
- Compensation structures are standardized to maintain consistency across comparable roles.
- Offers are prepared in alignment with internal equity and approved compensation frameworks.
Rakheja Enterprises LLP is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where all employees have equal access to professional development, learning opportunities, and career advancement.
This policy ensures that promotions, appraisals, and professional development initiatives are conducted without discrimination, bias, or unfair treatment. The Company promotes fairness, accessibility, and inclusivity in all aspects of employee growth and career progression.
## Fair and Merit Based Promotion Process
## Merit-Based Promotion Process
- Promotions are determined solely by performance, skills, experience, and demonstrated potential, without consideration of personal characteristics or background.
- Employees are evaluated based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), contributions to organizational objectives, and leadership capabilities.
- A structured and transparent performance review process ensures that all employees have an equitable opportunity for career growth and advancement.
## Transparent Promotion Process
- Promotion criteria and available opportunities are communicated clearly to all employees through official channels such as emails, internal portals, and team meetings.
- Employees have access to well-defined career paths and development plans to support their growth within the organization.
- Employees who meet the eligibility requirements for promotion are encouraged to apply.
- Promotion decisions are reviewed by a diverse panel to ensure objectivity, fairness, and minimal bias.
## Equal Access to Career Development
- All employees are given equitable access to skill development programs, mentorship initiatives, and leadership training opportunities.
- Career development programs are periodically reviewed to remove barriers and ensure inclusivity for all employees.
- Managers and HR personnel are trained to identify and prevent bias when recommending employees for development programs or promotions.
- Employees are encouraged to voice any concerns regarding potential barriers to their professional growth, ensuring a transparent and supportive environment.
## Preventing Discrimination in Career Development
## Bias-Free Evaluation System
- All performance appraisals and promotion decisions follow a standardized evaluation framework to minimize subjective bias.
- A structured feedback process ensures employees receive constructive evaluations along with a clear roadmap for growth and skill development.
- Anonymous employee feedback surveys are conducted periodically to monitor fairness and inclusivity in professional development practices.

chapters.title: Performance Evaluation & Career Progression
chapters.text:
Performance evaluations are conducted annually to assess:
- Achievement of assigned objectives
- Key strengths and areas for improvement
- Development and career growth opportunities
- Promotions, role enhancements, and salary increments are determined based on measurable performance indicators, achievement of targets, and formal managerial feedback.
## WORKPLACE STANDARDS AND EXPECTATIONS
At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are committed to maintaining a fair, professional, and productive work environment. These guidelines outline expectations related to working hours, compensation, employment practices, and employee conduct to ensure clarity, consistency, and equitable treatment across the organization.
## Working Hours, Attendance & Overtime Guidelines
## 🔹 Standard Working Hours
- The normal workweek is Monday to Saturday, with Sunday observed as Holiday, unless operational requirements specify otherwise.
- Standard working hours are 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., inclusive of a one-hour lunch break from 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m.
- Subject to role requirements and managerial approval, employees may request a flexible start time within a 30-minute window.
## 🔹 Attendance & Time Recording
- The company uses a biometric attendance system to record employee working hours.
- Employees working remotely or in the field are required to record attendance through the designated HR system or reporting mechanism.
- Repeated late arrivals or early departures without approval may result in corrective action in line with company policy.
## 🔹 Overtime & Additional Working Hours
- Any work performed beyond normal working hours is considered overtime.
- Overtime must be approved in advance by the reporting manager or authorized supervisor and accurately recorded.
- Employees required to work on weekends or public holidays may be eligible for compensatory leave or overtime compensation, subject to applicable company policies and local labor laws.
## 🔹 Compliance & Monitoring
- Attendance records are reviewed periodically to ensure compliance with working hour requirements.
- Employees may receive attendance summaries detailing working hours, leave records, and overtime, where applicable.
- Non-compliance, including unapproved absences or incorrect attendance reporting, may lead to disciplinary action in accordance with company procedures.
## Health Safety and Employee Wellbeing
Rakheja Enterprises LLP is committed to providing a safe, healthy, and supportive working environment for all employees, contractors, and visitors. We believe that protecting physical health, ensuring workplace safety, and promoting psychological wellbeing are essential to sustainable business performance and employee engagement.
This guideline outlines our approach to managing workplace health and safety risks, preventing occupational illness and injury, and supporting the mental and emotional wellbeing of our workforce.
## 🔹 Workplace Health & Safety
- The Company ensures compliance with applicable occupational health and safety laws, rules, and statutory requirements.
- Workplace hazards are identified through periodic inspections, risk assessments, and safety reviews.
- Safe work procedures, guidelines, and instructions are communicated to employees based on job roles and site conditions.
- Employees are required to follow safety instructions, use provided safety equipment, and immediately report unsafe conditions or incidents.
## 🔹 Physical Health at Work
- Rakheja Enterprises LLP promotes healthy work practices to reduce the risk of injury, illness, and fatigue.
- Work processes, tasks, and the physical work environment are designed and reviewed, where feasible, to incorporate ergonomic principles and minimize risks associated with repetitive movements, overuse, and prolonged static postures.
- Workstations and work practices are periodically assessed and adjusted, where practicable, to reduce discomfort or strain affecting muscles, tendons, or nerves.
- Employees are encouraged to adopt safe work techniques, take appropriate breaks, and follow guidance related to posture, movement, and equipment use.
- First-aid facilities and emergency medical support are maintained at Company workplaces, as applicable.
- Employees are encouraged to promptly report work-related injuries, discomfort, or health concerns to enable timely support, ergonomic adjustments, and corrective action.
## 🔹 Managing Risks from Repetitive Work Activities
- The Company takes preventive measures to reduce the risk of Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI) that may result from repetitive tasks, prolonged sitting, or improper workstation setup.
- Employees are encouraged to maintain proper posture while working and to adjust chairs, desks, and computer screens to ergonomic positions where applicable.
- Regular short breaks and stretching exercises are encouraged to reduce muscle fatigue and strain during repetitive or computer-based work.

chapters.title: 🔹 Employee Benefits
chapters.text:
## Health Insurance Coverage
- All eligible full-time employees are covered under the company-sponsored health insurance program.
- Coverage includes medical care and may extend to dental and vision benefits, as applicable.
- Dependents, including spouse and children up to 18 years of age, may be included as per policy terms.
- The health plan covers both work-related and non-work-related illnesses, injuries, or accidents.
## Medical Care and Wellness Support
- Preventive health initiatives such as periodic health check-ups and vaccination programs may be provided.
- Access to mental health support and counselling services is encouraged.
- Emergency medical treatment, hospitalization, ambulance services, and emergency transportation are covered in line with policy terms and approved healthcare providers.
## 🔹 Health Care Reimbursement
- Employees opting for medical treatment outside the company’s insurance network may apply for reimbursement, subject to policy conditions.
- Eligible expenses may include doctor consultations, prescribed medicines, and diagnostic tests.
- Claims must be submitted with supporting documentation within 30 days of treatment.
- Enrollment in health benefit plans is completed during onboarding or designated enrollment periods, and claims are processed through HR.

## Employee Representation, Social Dialogue & Collective Bargaining
- Rakheja Enterprises LLP promotes open, transparent, and constructive social dialogue to strengthen trust and positive workplace relations.
- The Company respects employees’ rights to representation through recognized employee representatives, committees, or legally constituted bodies, in line with applicable laws.
- Periodic collective bargaining discussions are conducted to address wages, working hours, health and safety, employee welfare, and other employment-related matters.
- Management and employee representatives engage in regular communication to resolve workplace concerns in a fair and timely manner.
- These practices support compliance with labour laws and contribute to a harmonious, inclusive, and respectful work environment.
## EMPLOYEE DEVELOPMENT AND CAREER PROGRESSION
At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we recognize the importance of continuous learning, skill enhancement, and internal career growth in building a strong and capable workforce. The organization is committed to supporting employee development through structured training, performance feedback, and opportunities for role-based advancement.
## Learning and Career Development
- Training & Skill Development: Employees may be provided access to internal training sessions, workshops, or online learning resources relevant to their roles and operational requirements.
- Leadership Development: Employees demonstrating strong performance and potential may be considered for leadership development initiatives, including supervisory or management-focused training programs.
- Educational Support Tuition Reimbursement: Subject to management approval, employees may apply for financial assistance or support for job-related certifications, skill programs, or higher education aligned with business needs.
- Individual Development Planning: Employees may work with their reporting managers to identify development goals and skill requirements. Development plans, where applicable, are reviewed periodically to support performance improvement and career progression.
## nternal Growth and Role Movement
To retain top talent and enhance employee engagement, Rakheja Enterprises LLP has implemented structured internal mobility programs, encouraging employees to explore different career paths within the company.
## ertical Mobility (Career Progression & Leadership Growth)
- Employees who consistently demonstrate strong performance, accountability, technical competence, and leadership potential are considered for higher responsibilities and managerial roles.
- Promotions are based on performance metrics, business impact, operational knowledge, and alignment with company values.
## Horizontal Mobility (Cross-Functional Opportunities)
- To build well-rounded professionals, employees may explore opportunities across departments at the same level, enabling skill expansion and better business understanding.

chapters.title: Anti-Harassment Guideline
chapters.text:
Rakheja Enterprises LLP is committed to maintaining a workplace that is safe, respectful, and free from harassment. The Company has a zero-tolerance for any form of harassment, including but not limited to sexual harassment, workplace bullying, verbal abuse, discrimination, or any behavior that creates a hostile or intimidating work environment.
This guideline outlines the measures and procedures in place to prevent harassment, protect employees, and promote a safe, inclusive, and professional workplace for all.
## Understanding Workplace Harassment
Harassment refers to any unwelcome behaviour—verbal, physical, or non-verbal—that creates a hostile, intimidating, or offensive work environment.
Harassment includes, but is not limited to:
- Verbal Harassment: Insults, offensive jokes, derogatory remarks, or threats.
- Physical Harassment: Unwelcome touching, assault, or physical intimidation.
- Sexual Harassment: Unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favours, or inappropriate sexual comments.
- Psychological Harassment: Persistent bullying, intimidation, or manipulative behavior.
- Discriminatory Harassment: Actions targeting an individual based on race, gender, disability, religion, or any other legally protected characteristic.
## Harassment Prevention and Awareness
## Employee Awareness and Training
- All employees undergo mandatory harassment prevention training during onboarding and refresher sessions annually.
- Awareness campaigns, workshops, and seminars are conducted to educate employees on workplace respect, professional behavior, and maintaining a safe environment.
- Clear guidelines are provided to help employees identify, report, and prevent harassment in the workplace.
## Workplace Conduct & Zero-Tolerance Policy
- A strict Code of Conduct defines acceptable and unacceptable workplace behavior.
- The Company enforces a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, applicable to all employees, contractors, and vendors.
- Employees are encouraged to engage in bystander intervention and take proactive steps to prevent harassment incidents.
## Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
- Regular audits and workplace assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of anti-harassment policies and initiatives.
- Employee feedback surveys are used to identify gaps and areas for improvement in workplace conduct and safety.
## Reporting & Remediation
- Any incidents of harassment, discrimination, or workplace bullying must be reported promptly through Rakheja Enterprises LLP’s Grievance Mechanism.
- All reported cases are investigated fairly, confidentially, and without retaliation. Investigations follow the Company’s structured remediation process to address and resolve concerns effectively.
## EMPLOYEE GRIEVANCE MECHANISM & RESOLUTION PROCESS
Rakheja Enterprises LLP is dedicated to maintaining a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace where employees and stakeholders can raise concerns without fear of retaliation.
The Grievance Mechanism provides a structured and transparent process for reporting, reviewing, and resolving workplace-related issues. It ensures that all grievances are addressed fairly, confidentially, and in a timely manner, fostering trust and accountability within the organization.
## Coverage of the Grievance Mechanism
The Grievance Mechanism applies to all employees, suppliers, contractors, and other stakeholders associated with Rakheja Enterprises LLP. It addresses workplace concerns and grievances, including but not limited to:
- Employee Health & Safety: Unsafe working conditions, lack of protective equipment, exposure to hazardous materials, or violations of occupational health standards.
- Harassment & Discrimination: Any form of workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, bullying, or discrimination based on gender, race, nationality, religion, disability, or other protected characteristics.
- Labor & Human Rights Issues: Violations related to unfair wages, excessive working hours, denial of legally mandated breaks, forced or bonded labour, child labour, human trafficking, or denial of freedom of association and collective bargaining rights.
- Governance & Ethical Issues: Ethical misconduct, corruption, bribery, conflicts of interest, fraudulent activities, or breaches of company policies.
- Wage & Benefit Disputes: Non-payment of wages, disputes over benefits, or unfair deductions from salaries.
- Unfair Treatment & Retaliation: Complaints regarding unfair disciplinary actions, wrongful termination, or retaliation for reporting concerns.
- Environmental & Sustainability Concerns: Violations of environmental policies, improper waste management, or non-compliance with sustainability commitments.

chapters.title: Grievance Resolution & Closure Process
chapters.text:
- Acknowledgment: The complainant receives acknowledgment of the grievance within five business days of submission.
- Preliminary Review: HR and Compliance Officers conduct an initial review to assess the severity, urgency, and validity of the complaint.
- Investigation: A formal investigation is carried out by an internal or external independent team, depending on the nature and complexity of the grievance.
- Resolution & Action: Appropriate corrective measures are implemented if the grievance is substantiated, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
- Feedback & Closure: Where feasible, the complainant is informed of the outcome while maintaining confidentiality and respecting the privacy of all parties involved.
## Monitoring, Feedback & Continuous Improvement
- Regular audits and assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of the grievance mechanism.
- Employee feedback is actively collected to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
- Training programs are provided to employees and management to reinforce the importance of ethical, fair, and transparent grievance handling.
## REMEDIATION & CORRECTIVE ACTION PROCEDURE
Rakheja Enterprises LLP is committed to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and ethical workplace. This remediation procedure ensures that all grievances including discrimination, harassment, health & safety violations, labour & human rights concerns, and governance issues are addressed in a fair, transparent, and effective manner.
## Coverage of Remediation Procedures
This remediation procedure applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders associated with Rakheja Enterprises LLP and covers complaints and concerns including, but not limited to, the following:
- Discrimination & Harassment: Workplace bullying, gender bias, racial or religious discrimination, or any other form of unfair treatment.
- Health & Safety Violations: Unsafe working conditions, inadequate safety measures, or non-compliance with occupational health standards.
- Labor & Human Rights Violations: Unfair wages, excessive working hours, forced or bonded labour, human trafficking, child labour, or any other form of exploitation or violation of fundamental labour rights.
- Governance & Ethical Breaches: Corruption, bribery, conflicts of interest, or other unethical practices.
- Retaliation against Whistleblowers: Any adverse action against individuals who report concerns in good faith.
## Remediation Process
## A. Reporting & Initial Response
- Complaint Submission: Employees and stakeholders may report grievances through the following channels:
- Confidential Email: hrd132@rakhejaenterprises.com (Monitored by HR and Compliance)
- Dedicated Hotline: +91-124-4994700-45 (Reachable during office hours via HR or Compliance)
- HR department, direct managers, or anonymous reporting channels
- Grievance Mechanism: Complaints may also be formally registered through the company’s grievance mechanism for structured resolution
- Acknowledgment: All submitted grievances are acknowledged within five business days, confirming receipt and outlining the next steps in the process.
- Non-Retaliation & Confidentiality: All reports are handled with strict confidentiality.
- Retaliation against individuals who submit complaints in good faith is strictly prohibited.
## B. Investigation & Fact-Finding
- Assignment of Investigators: HR, Compliance Officers, or an independent investigator (for serious or complex cases) are assigned to lead the inquiry.
- Data Collection: Relevant documentation, witness statements, and other evidence are collected and reviewed thoroughly.
- Preliminary Findings Report: Within 15–30 days, an initial report is prepared summarizing the findings and highlighting any potential policy or legal violations.
## C. Corrective & Remedial Actions
1. Implementation of Appropriate Measures: Based on investigation outcomes, Rakheja Enterprises LLP may take the following actions:
- Policy Revisions & Training: Address systemic issues through additional employee education and awareness programs.
- Disciplinary Actions: Warnings, suspension, or termination may be applied to individuals found responsible.
- Restorative Support for Affected Employees: Counseling, compensation, or professional rehabilitation support, where applicable.
- Workplace Adjustments: Transfers, restructuring, or enhanced monitoring to prevent recurrence of incidents.
2. Transparency & Follow-Up: All relevant parties are provided with updates on the corrective actions within 30–60 days, wherever feasible.
3. Legal & Compliance Measures: If legal violations are identified, the company coordinates with appropriate regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with applicable laws.
